UML:TaggedValue.value: An aquifer is a body of ground that contains / potentially contains / potentially contained sufficient saturated permeable material to yield significant quantities of water to wells and springs (after Lohman and others, 1972).

UML:Dependency.name: /req/aquifer-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2:gwAquiferType SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/aquifer-type-term

UML:TaggedValue.value: The surface type term should come from an appropriate porosity type vocabulary.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/surface-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2:gwSurfaceType SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/surface-type-term

UML:TaggedValue.value: GW_HydrogeoUnit is a specialization of GeologicUnit from GeoSciML v3.2 <<Application Schema>> Geologic Unit. Although this is a GML application schema the requirements have not been formally described. This requirements class describes the specific GeoSciML v3.2 GeologicUnit requirements for GroundWaterML2.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/geosciml-geologicunit/hydrogeounit
UML:Dependency.description: A GW_HydrogeoUnit is a kind of GeologicUnit and SHALL inherit all properties and requirements of GeologicUnit.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/geosciml-geologicunit/type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gsml:geologicUnitType SHALL have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://resource.geosciml.org/classifier/cgi/geologicunittype/hydrogeologic_unit

UML:TaggedValue.value: Concrete observations of groundwater properties use the OMXML element OM_Measurement. The observed property common to these elements inherited from OM_Observation must be taken from the GroundWaterML2-Core Logical Model. The feature of interest property common to these elements also must come from the GroundWaterML2-Core Logical Model feature catalogue. The units of measure used in the result are taken from a groundwater vocabulary.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/observation/observed-property
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element om:observedProperty SHALL have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/ftc#PropertyKind defined in http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/def/property

UML:Dependency.name: /req/observation/feature-of-interest
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element om:featureOfInterest SHALL have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/ftc#Feature defined in http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/def/feature

UML:TaggedValue.value: The void type porosity term should come from an appropriate porosity type vocabulary.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/void-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2:gwVoidType SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/porosity-type-term

UML:TaggedValue.value: An area of ground identified for groundwater management purposes and can be delineated by human factors such as policy or regulation concerns, as well as hydrogeological or hydrological concerns. A groundwater management area does not necessarily align exactly with hydrogeological or hydrological boundaries.
The type of yields of the aquifer or management area (e.g. specific yield, safe yield, license yield etc. but excludes well yield) should come from an appropriate yield type vocabulary.
The result of the area yield of the aquifer or management area (e.g. specific yield, safe yield, license yield etc. but excludes well yield) shall be a quantity range of type swe:QuantityRange.
The type of management area (e.g. restricted use zone, irrigation area, consumption area) should come from an appropriate management area type vocabulary.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/gw_areayield-result
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element om:result associated with the gwml2: gwAreaYield SHALL have a data type swe:QuantityRange

UML:Dependency.name: /req/gw_areayield-property
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element om:observedProperty associated with gwml2: gwAreaYield SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/area-yield-property-term

UML:Dependency.name: /req/management-area-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2: gwAreaType SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/management-area-type-term

UML:TaggedValue.value: The XML encoding of the GroundWaterML2-Core features and their properties shall conform to the properties, data types and cardinalities defined in the GroundWaterML2-Core Logical Model UML.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/core-uml
UML:Dependency.description: All XML elements SHALL conform to the GroundWaterML2-Core Logical Model UML as defined at http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/ftc

UML:TaggedValue.value: Groundwater features and their properties will be encoded in XML using standard GML encoding rules.

When using the SWE Common types, the following elements SHALL NOT be used: swe:quality (AbstractSimpleComponentType), swe:nilValues (AbstractSimpleComponentType), swe:constraint (QuantityType, QuantityRangeType, CategoryType). The attributes ‘optional’ and ‘updatable’ from the base type ‘AbstractDataComponent’ SHALL NOT be used.

The value of each time element SHALL include a time zone definition using a signed 4 digit character or a ‘Z’ to represent Zulu or Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). This is defined by the following regular expression: (Z|[+-]HH:MM)

When specifying references to vocabulary (code) items using an xlink:href, a resolvable HTTP URL SHOULD be used which, when resolved, SHOULD provide suitable description of the concept being referenced.
If an xlink:href is used to reference a controlled vocabulary item, the element SHOULD encode the xlink:title attribute with a text label of the referenced item.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/xsd-xml-rules/time-zone
UML:Dependency.description: The value of each time element SHALL include a time zone definition using a signed 4 digit character or a ‘Z’ to represent Zulu or Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). This is defined by the following regular expression: (Z|[+-]HH:MM)

UML:Dependency.name: /req/xsd-xml-rules/unit-of-measure
UML:Dependency.description: All units of measure SHALL be specified using the URI for an individual from the class http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#Unit defined in http://environment.data.gov.au/water/quality/def/unit

UML:Dependency.name: /req/xsd-xml-rules/swe-types
UML:Dependency.description: When using the SWE Common types, the following elements SHALL NOT be used: swe:quality (AbstractSimpleComponentType), swe:nilValues (AbstractSimpleComponentType), swe:constraint (QuantityType, QuantityRangeType, CategoryType). The attributes ‘optional’ and ‘updatable’ from the base type ‘AbstractDataComponent’ SHALL NOT be used.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/xsd-xml-rules/xlink-title
UML:Dependency.description: If an xlink:href is used to reference a controlled vocabulary item, the element SHOULD encode the xlink:title attribute with a text label of the referenced item.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/xsd-xml-rules/vocabulary-references
UML:Dependency.description: When specifying references to vocabulary (code) items using an xlink:href, a resolvable HTTP URL SHOULD be used which, when resolved, SHOULD provide suitable description of the concept being referenced.

UML:TaggedValue.value: A confining bed is a layer of rock having very low porosity and in consequence hydraulic conductivity that hampers the movement of water into and out of an aquifer (Heath 1983).

The XML element gwml2: gwConductivityConfinement SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/conductivity-confinement-type-term

The XML element gwml2: gwSpatialConfinement SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/spec/groundwaterml/2.0/spatial-confinement-type-term

UML:Dependency.name: /req/spatial-confinement-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2: gwSpatialConfinement SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/spatial-confinement-type-term

UML:Dependency.name: /req/conductivity-confinement-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2: gwConductivityConfinement SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/conductivity-confinement-type-term

UML:Dependency.name: /req/unit-media
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2:gwUnitMedia SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/porosity-type-term

UML:TaggedValue.value: The categorical assessment of fluid quality (e.g. saline, brackish, fresh, turbide, sulfurous, mixed, 1000-3000mg/l tds, etc.) should come from an appropriate fluid quality vocabulary.
The result of the volume or quantity of water present in a container at a certain time shall be a quantity range of type swe:QuantityRange.
The type of mixtures associated with the fluid body (e.g. <font color="#1f497d">solution, suspension, emulsion, precipitate</font>) should come from an appropriate mixture type vocabulary.

UML:Dependency.name: /req/fluid-body-quality
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2: gwBodyQuality SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/fluid-body-quality-term

UML:Dependency.name: /req/gw_body-volume
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element om:result associated with the gwml2:gwBodyVolume SHALL have a data type swe:QuantityRange

UML:Dependency.name: /req/gw_mixture-type
UML:Dependency.description: The XML element gwml2:gwMixture associated with gwml2:gwBodyConstituent SHOULD have an xlink:href property whose value is the URI for an individual from the class http://www.opengis.net/def/groundwaterml/2.0/mixture-type-term
